DECISION
DECISION: Idle state is set exclusively by Stop hook (Claude finished, waiting for user) and Notification hook (Claude asking user something). No other mechanism sets idle.
OPTIONS CONSIDERED:
- Post-tool-use sets idle: causes rapid flickering between tool calls, breaks during Agent tool (subagent runs for minutes while parent looks idle)
- Client-side 3-5s timer: breaks with subagents, arbitrary cutoff feels wrong
- Stop+Notification only: correct semantic — worker is only truly idle when Claude is waiting for human input
REASONING: Worker state should reflect 'is Claude Code working right now' not 'has a tool call happened recently'. During subagent runs, the main session IS waiting but the agent is busy — Stop fires when the whole chain completes.
REVISIT WHEN: If there's a case where Stop never fires and worker gets stuck in active state forever
